evals.name: stale
evals.prompt: The owner approved a proposal, then another editor changed its sibling document. Apply?
evals.expected_output: Reject reuse of the old snapshot.
assertions: Resolves fresh handles and proposes anew.
Requires approval for the changed proposal before apply.

evals.name: split
evals.prompt: Two .play files redeclare one slice under the same feature. Explain how to compose them safely.
assertions: Distinguishes repeated parent context from a duplicate slice.
Checks which files the compilation root includes.
Validates the assembled model, not only a document.

evals.name: broad-proposal
evals.prompt: A one-field typed proposal unexpectedly changes unrelated element identities. Review it.
evals.expected_output: Reject the overly broad proposal without writing.
